mapper.select: SELECT l.*, s.name AS student_name, s.student_no, COALESCE(l.letter_file_id, af.pk_archive_file) AS letter_file_id FROM archive_transfer_letter l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.pk_student LEFT JOIN archive_file af ON l.letter_file_path = af.file_path WHERE l.pk_letter = #{pkLetter}

SELECT l.*, s.name AS student_name, s.student_no, COALESCE(l.letter_file_id, af.pk_archive_file) AS letter_file_id FROM archive_transfer_letter l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.pk_student LEFT JOIN archive_file af ON l.letter_file_path = af.file_path WHERE l.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY l.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_transfer_letter (student_id, destination_type, destination_name, destination_address, contact_person, contact_phone, letter_file_path, letter_file_id, reason) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{destinationType}, #{destinationName}, #{destinationAddress}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{letterFilePath}, #{letterFileId}, #{reason})
